# OpenSocrates 1.2.0

OpenSocrates 1.2.0 adds first-class OpenCode support.

## OpenCode

- OpenCode 1.18.18+ automatically discovers the generated global plugin and
  native `opensocrates` Agent Skill.
- The stable `chat.message` bridge can inject one complete authored procedure
  into the same model turn after bounded local judgment classification.
- Mechanical, malformed, oversized, timed-out, and exceptional inputs fail
  open. The bridge makes no extra model, network, subprocess, or recursive
  OpenCode call.
- A real `opencode run` validated the exact generated bridge on OpenCode
  1.18.18 with DeepSeek V4 Flash in both `opencode run` and the interactive
  TUI. Native skill invocation remains unverified (discovery was validated).

## Lifecycle and release safety

- `install`, `status`, `verify`, `update`, `remove`, rollback, automatic
  updates, and `--host all` now include OpenCode.
- The installer owns only the OpenSocrates bridge, its sidecar, and the
  `opensocrates` skill directory. It preserves unrelated OpenCode files and
  never rewrites `opencode.json`.
- Package and installed inventories, checksums, manifests, generated content,
  ownership, deterministic archives, and release workflow assets are checked.

```sh
npx --yes opensocrates@1.2.0 install --host opencode
npx --yes opensocrates@1.2.0 update --host all
```

See [the OpenCode support boundary](../../docs/opencode-support.md) for exact
validation levels and remaining limitations.
